query: SELECT c.conrelid::regclass::text AS table_name, c.conname, pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid) AS definition FROM pg_constraint c WHERE c.conrelid IN ('public.orders'::regclass, 'public.shipments'::regclass, 'public.payments'::regclass, 'public.product_reviews'::regclass) ORDER BY table_name, c.conname LIMIT 100;
